trustProxy.description: Honor X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP / CF-Connecting-IP for getClientIp. Default false (headers are spoofable). Env: SERVER_TRUST_PROXY=1.

publicOrigin.description: Public origin (scheme + host) when behind a TLS-terminating proxy. Used for self-referential URLs. Env: SERVER_PUBLIC_ORIGIN.

maxFileSize.description: Max upload size in bytes (default 10 MB)

signedUrlSecret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for signed asset URLs. Env-only: ASSETS_SIGNED_URL_SECRET. Falls back to auth.jwtSecret.

travelPrompts.description: Bound/linked travel mode: prompt the LLM to narrate travel and suggest moving the chat to another location/chat when the narrative leaves the current one

jsonlMaxBytes.description: Max JSONL file bytes before rotation

sessionToken.description: Bearer token for authenticated chat routes; omit to run anonymous against solo deployments.

demoAutoSetup.description: Auto-create sample data on first demo run

adminUsername.description: Bootstrap admin username (multi-user mode). Set via config or AUTH_ADMIN_USERNAME env.

adminPassword.description: Bootstrap admin password (multi-user mode). Env-only preferred: AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD. Never commit.

jwtSecret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for JWT signing. Env-only: AUTH_JWT_SECRET. Required when auth.required=true.

csrfSecret.description: HMAC secret for Bun.CSRF token issuance + verification. Env-only: AUTH_CSRF_SECRET. Falls back to auth.jwtSecret when unset.

legacyOpaqueTokenFallback.description: Permit sha256(token) lookup when JWT verify fails. Default false. Set AUTH_LEGACY_OPAQUE_TOKEN_FALLBACK=1 only for one-shot legacy migrations.

defaultNsfwScope.description: Default NSFW scope for new chats

auditLogging.description: Log NSFW gate decisions to audit trail

piiSecret.description: HMAC secret for NSFW PII pseudonymization. Env-only: NSFW_PII_SECRET. Required in production.

reporterHashSecret.description: HMAC secret for moderation reporter-hash projection. Env-only: NSFW_FLAG_REPORTER_HASH_SECRET. Falls back to nsfw.piiSecret when unset.

useLlmClassifier.description: Augment NSFW keyword detection with an LLM content rating classifier

observability.description: Observability exposure (liveness/readiness probes + Prometheus metrics). All opt-in.

piiSecret.description: HMAC secret for admin-telemetry PII hashing. Env-only: TELEMETRY_PII_SECRET. Required in production.

hooks.description: Content hooks configuration (mood, emotion, NSFW, moderation)

enableModerationLlmClassifier.description: LLM moderation verdict alongside keyword scan

idempotency.description: Global idempotency middleware for re-fired mutating requests

enabled.description: Enable the global idempotency middleware. Env: IDEMPOTENCY_ENABLED=0 to disable.

backend.description: Cache backend: 'memory' (single-instance) or 'table' (shared across instances via request_results). Env: IDEMPOTENCY_BACKEND.

ttlMs.description: TTL for cached idempotent responses in ms. Default 24h. Env: IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_MS.

bypassHeader.description: Honor X-Idempotency-Bypass: 1 to skip the cache. Env: IDEMPOTENCY_BYPASS_HEADER=0 to disable.

routing.description: Model routing policy applied to the provider failover order

strategy.description: Ordering strategy: "capability-match" (default, no-op for unannotated models), "cheapest", "fastest", or "round-robin"

fallbacks.description: Hard cap on the fallback chain; entries past it are dropped

autoStart.description: Auto-spawn external AI servers at startup

llamaCpp.description: Spawn llama.cpp server as child process

nGpuLayers.description: GPU layers: number, auto, or all

mlock.description: Force model to stay in RAM

cacheTypeK.description: KV cache type for K: f32, f16, q8_0, iq4_nl...

cacheRam.description: KV cache RAM budget in MiB

flashAttn.description: Flash attention: on, off, or auto

specDraftNMin.description: Min draft tokens for spec decoding

specDraftNMax.description: Max draft tokens for spec decoding

modelType.description: checkpoint = standalone (-m), diffusion = component (--diffusion-model, needs llm)

llmPath.description: LLM text encoder GGUF. Needed for most diffusion models.

vaeFormat.description: VAE latent format: auto, flux, sd3, flux2

diffusionFA.description: Flash attention in diffusion model only

vaeTiling.description: Process VAE in tiles to reduce memory

eagerLoad.description: Load all params at model-load time

offloadToCPU.description: Place weights in RAM, load to VRAM on demand

autoFit.description: Auto-pick device placements from model size + VRAM budget

type.description: Weight type: f32, f16, q4_0, q8_0, etc.

prediction.description: Prediction type: eps, v, edm_v, sd3_flow, flux_flow

backend.description: Matting backend: "none" disables matting; "http" posts bytes to `endpoint`; "rembg" talks to a rembg server; "comfy" runs the native BiRefNet workflow; "auto" picks comfy, then rembg, then http

endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint ("http": URL accepting image bytes, returning PNG; "rembg": server base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7000)

model.description: Matting model ("rembg": model name, default isnet-general-use; bria-rmbg/RMBG-* weights are non-commercial; "comfy": background_removal weights file, default birefnet.safetensors)

apiKey.description: Optional bearer token for the generic "http" backend

decontaminate.description: rembg only: request edge color decontamination (default true)

autoEnqueue.description: Auto-enqueue matting after emotion-avatar generation (default true)

encryptionKey.description: Encryption key for stored API keys

serverEncryptionKey.description: 256-bit hex key. Missing = encryption disabled (dev mode).

required.description: true = refuse to start without SMK (prod guard)
